plugins.name: personal-data-protection
plugins.description: Multi-agent SEA personal-data-protection compliance reference for engineers — packaged as both a Claude Code skill and a Codex plugin. Singapore PDPA, Thailand PDPA, Indonesia UU PDP, Malaysia PDPA (Act 709 + A1727), Philippines Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), and Vietnam PDPL (91/2025/QH15). Tech-agnostic, organised by where in the stack each obligation lands rather than by statute section. Reference material, not legal advice.
